versions.subject: feat: update clickonce rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: '\SOFTWARE\MICROSOFT\.NETFramework\Security\TrustManager\PromptingLevel\'
    TargetObject|endswith:
        - '\Internet'
        - '\LocalIntranet'
        - '\MyComputer'
        - '\TrustedSites'
        - '\UntrustedSites'
    Details: 'Enabled'
condition: selection
